regressions.baseline: 5 tests, 9 assertions, 3 failures for block current language, cookie fallback and explicit language.
regressions.hposAfter: 36 integration tests, 82 assertions; 9 unit tests, 22 assertions; all passed.
regressions.legacyAfter: OrderLanguageTest: 5 tests, 11 assertions, all passed under verified CPT storage.

limits: Cookie disabled configuration and nonbrowser Store API clients without language are not fully accepted.
Full translated email catalogs, stock/refunds, coupons and account/report behavior remain pending.
Block checkout with legacy storage has hook regression coverage, not a browser purchase yet.
evidenceHandling: Only URL paths and sanitized order outcomes are saved. Session headers, nonces, order keys and customer addresses are omitted.
